samples.evidence: We have investigated the suicidal process in male prisoners through semi-structured interviews with 60 prisoners who made near-lethal suicide attempts. (004_the_suicidal_process_in_male_prisoners_making_near p1 study=1); The Ministry of Justice Safer Custody and Offender Policy Group at the Home Office calculated that 19 prisons were likely, based on past rates of completed suicide and serious suicide attempts, to provide 60 near-lethal suicide attempts within the time period allocated for data collection. (007_participating_prisons p5 study=1); Between 1 June 2007 and 6 February 2009 we interviewed 60 male prisoners from 19 prisons who had made near-lethal suicide attempts. (015_results p7 study=1); We conducted a thematic analysis of 60 interviews with male prisoners who had made near-lethal suicide attempts in order to gain a better understanding of the suicidal process likely to be involved in suicide by prisoners. (031_discussion p16 study=1)
